fixes.description: The test verifies HashMap behaves identically to dict, so results must be equal (==), not unequal (!=); the != was a typo causing every operation that returns None to fail.

explanation: Line 83 of the test file has a typo: `assert my_res != py_res` should be `assert my_res == py_res`. The test `test_hash_map_is_the_same_as_dict` is meant to verify that HashMap produces the same result as a Python dict for every operation, but the `!=` operator makes it assert the opposite — causing failures whenever both results are `None` (e.g., after any `setitem` or `delitem` call).
